source_name: Bay County Board of County Commissioners: agendas (PrimeGov, calendar (iCal cat 38))
refresh: Every 30 minutes on weekdays, and twice a day
what_we_take: Meeting dates, agendas, packets, minutes and agenda items
how_we_process: Each government's agenda system is checked every 30 minutes on weekdays (when a notice email arrives) and swept twice a day. Every agenda, packet and minutes file is downloaded and fingerprinted; a changed file is kept as a new version. An AI model reads each new agenda into a list of items using only the agenda's own words (it is told not to guess). The meetings list combines the agenda system with the government's calendar; boards with no calendar get dates from their regular schedule, marked "expected".
checks: Failed fetches are logged and emailed to the site admins. Every version of every file is kept.
